build_fbnet_fpn_single_resolution: build an FBNet FPN model with a single resolution path using FBNetFPNBuilder and FBNetBuilder
build_fbnet_fpn_multi_resolution: build an FBNet FPN model with multiple resolution paths and cross-path connections using FBNetFPNBuilder
build_fbnet_fpn_skip_connections: build an FBNet FPN model with skip connections using noop operations for unused inputs
build_fbnet_fpn_high_to_low: build an FBNet FPN model with high-to-low resolution stages using conv_k3 and noop operations
build_fbnet_fpn_low_to_high: build an FBNet FPN model with low-to-high resolution stages using upsample and conv_k3 operations
